name: lounge-deploy
description: Prepare project-aware Lounge thumbnails and validate static upload ZIPs, with Studio publishing guidance and optional ranking/display name integration.

interface.shortDescription: Lounge thumbnails, static ZIP validation, and Studio guidance
interface.longDescription: Analyze a single HTML, static web, Vite, or Next.js project; make only the minimum static-export changes; build and inspect the output locally; and use the current Let's Coding policy for final manifest validation and a Korean completion report. For score-based games, it can add the Lounge ranking SDK only when requested, and it can read the signed-in visitor's display name from the Lounge same-origin API for on-screen display only. Source files, ZIP bytes, environment values, and credentials are not sent to the MCP server. Actual Lounge upload is not included. Create project-aware 16:9 thumbnails from the current project and its character/background assets. Studio users publish through the existing Lounge publishing form instead of manually uploading a ZIP.
